thread:
maya: incident-bot just paged me for p99 spikes on hosted/production-embed during the midroll (new model v2.3 -> v3.0). seeing p95 ~ 320ms -> 1.2s and p99 up to 3.6s. streaming token stalls also reported. paging now :rotating_light:
incident-bot: ALERT: Hosted inference SLO breach on /generate-stream (prod region us-west). p99 latency > 3s (sustained 4m). Paging oncall: @oncall-sre.
oncall-sre: I'm on it. grabbing dashboard + deployment history. any active rollouts?
maya: yes, deploy-bot did a midroll earlier for model v3.0 -- it was 10% -> 40% traffic over the last 12m. deploy-bot: 
"deploy-bot: rollout started: model=\"v3.0\" from=\"v2.3\" strategy=\"midroll\" target=40% progress=12m"
ellie: I see the spike correlates with the rollout start at 1723456735. p50/p90 stable, p95 jumped at ~1723456750, p99 follows. streaming stalls show "token_timeout" in logs.
dinesh: attaching quick log snippet from the proxy (filtered):
```
[1723456762] conn=xyz request_id=abc path=/generate-stream model=v3.0 stage=canary step=decode duration_ms=1200
[1723456763] conn=xyz request_id=def path=/generate-stream model=v3.0 stage=canary stall=kv-cache-miss duration_ms=3100 token_timeout
[1723456764] conn=xyz request_id=ghi path=/generate-stream model=v2.3 stage=stable duration_ms=90
```
ryan: confirmed: v3.0 requests show 2-3s single-op stalls often at decode/kv cache layer. suspect quantized kernel fallback on some GPU variants.
sre-lead: Paging runbook step 1: notify customer-success if customers impacted, step 2: evaluate rapid rollback or traffic shift, step 3: mitigate streaming stalls by enabling non-stream fallback.
customer-success: FYI we already have two enterprise customers on the new model at 20% each via dedicated capacity; they're on us-west. I'll preemptively open support tickets and flag for SLA risk.
oncall-sre: quick mitigation suggestion: reduce midroll traffic back to 5% for v3.0 and shift remainder to v2.3, then start fast rollback if latency persists. can we do that via the rollout API?
maya: yes, using the rollout controller: `redwoodctl rollout set-weights --model v3.0=5 --model v2.3=95 --env prod --region us-west`
dinesh: running a dry-run to confirm no config drift.
deploy-bot: ACTION: adjusting rollout weights per request by maya. new weights: v3.0=5%, v2.3=95% (applied to us-west).
ellie: dashboards updating — p95 dropped from 1.2s -> ~420ms after weight shift started to apply (30s delay). p99 trending down but still elevated at ~1.1s. streaming errors count reduced by ~60%.
incident-bot: NOTE: mitigation in progress. auto-trace samples collected for the high-latency requests.
ryan: we should also check autoscaler / burst queue: if queues are accumulating they can cause spikes even after weight change. can someone grep queue_backlog across the pod set?
oncall-sre: I'm on queue metrics: backlog spiked to 800 reqs ~1723456768, now trending down to 120. CPUs on some hosts at 92% due to decode fallback.
sre-lead: decision call: keep v3.0 at 5% for now, continue monitoring 10m. if p99 > 1s for another 5m we abort rollout fully (rollback to v2.3). also open a follow-up in eng-runtime to investigate kernel selection for v3.0 on prod GPU type.
maya: agree. escalating to eng-runtime: @ryan please attach recent traces and the `decode` kernel logs.
ryan: attaching gist link to traces: https://redwood.gists/gt-172345 (private) and starting a ticket ENG-5721.
ellie: customer-impact note: one customer reported timeout for 3 requests during the spike. CS opened ticket CS-9012 and informed them we're mitigating.
dinesh: issuing quick config to enable non-stream fallback for requests older than 2s: `redwoodctl config set --path /services/inference/streaming/fallback_threshold_ms=2000 --env prod` — applying now.
oncall-sre: fallback applied. confirming streaming stalls drop: success metric shows 78% reduction in token_timeout errors for v3.0.
sre-lead: on-call handoff plan: oncall-sre keep monitoring for 30m, then hand off to next shift with runbook and notes. if any regression or new region impact, page immediately.
incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTES: root cause suspected: model v3.0 kernel fallback + KV-cache miss pattern on specific GPU SKU under mid-traffic conditions. mitigation: traffic reduction, streaming fallback enabled. Postmortem assigned to eng-runtime (ENG-5721). Severity: Sev3 -> under review.
maya: final check — SLAs currently degraded but recovery in progress. @customer-success please escalate to Tier 2 support for the affected enterprise customers and confirm whether they need immediate failover to dedicated capacity.
customer-success: acknowledged, reaching out to customers now. will update CS-9012 with mitigation steps and expected timeline. :telephone_receiver:
ryan: followup tasks: 1) rollback iff p99 > 1s after 5m, 2) run kernel repro on GPU-xyz, 3) add telemetry to detect kv-cache miss rate per-model.
ellie: logging this thread to incidents log and adding links to traces/tickets.
maya: thanks all — keeping this open for the next 30m. I'll post final handoff once stable. :white_check_mark:
